investigation.log_findings: Found outreach_recipients row with reason 'Send failed: t' (job a05c183d-57ff-40e9-9a27-864775e977ed, phone 105957396857003). In minified WhatsApp Web code, thrown error object is an exception t. When outreach.js did `Send failed: ${err.message}` without checking length or fallback, it logged 'Send failed: t'. Furthermore, src/utils/errors.js previously masked all status 502 errors to generic 500 'Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.', preventing operators and users from understanding upstream WhatsApp errors.
investigation.root_cause: CONFIRMED: Minified exceptions produce single-character error messages ('t'), and errorHandler in src/utils/errors.js previously treated status 502 as a generic server error instead of forwarding actionable, redacted upstream diagnostics. Frontend public/js/app.js api() and showToast() lacked un-truncation guards for single-character error responses.

changes: tests/live/harness.js: Added assertRecipientAllowlisted safety guard and test harness.
src/utils/errors.js: Permitted status 502 and upstream WA errors through with redacted details; replaced single-character errors with code/name.
src/services/outreach.js: Added fallback to err.code/stack/name when err.message is 't' or single character.
public/js/app.js: Updated api() to safely parse non-JSON responses and un-truncate single character errors; updated showToast() to handle error objects.
